stories.title: August power: Cubs cap record month with 9 HRs
stories.summary: The Cubs hit a franchise-record nine home runs in a 17-3 blowout of the Brewers on Monday night, capping a month in which they hit 62 total.

stories.title: Citing 'financial deficit,' UCLA fires AD Jarmond
stories.summary: UCLA fired athletic director Martin Jarmond on Monday, with chancellor Julio Frenk explaining in a letter to the UCLA community that the Bruins' athletic program "currently carries a significant financial deficit, and its current path is not sustainable."

stories.title: Police: TCU WR was hospitalized with brain bleed
stories.summary: TCU football player Dozie Ezukanma was hospitalized for three days because of a brain bleed, a concussion and other injuries after being punched and kicked in the head by then-teammate Jacob Fields, according to a signed arrest warrant affidavit.
